items.heading: How do I create a reservation?
items.body: Choose New reservation, enter guest and stay details, and save. Open the reservation to check the guest in or out.

items.heading: How does housekeeping work?
items.body: Move tasks through To do, In progress, Inspection, and Ready. Updates are saved on this device.

items.heading: What does this demo include?
items.body: The portfolio metrics are a September 23 snapshot. Reservations, housekeeping tasks, and guest issues are interactive examples. Exports contain reservation records for the selected property.
